summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found (read-only investigation, no changes made):**  The backend is actually built correctly — `watchlists` has a `NOT NULL user_id` column, every handler filters by `user_id`, and the client's `api.ts` sends cookies (`credentials: "include"`) on every request. There's no localStorage/guest fallback anywhere in the watchlist client code. So this isn't the "anonymous storage" bug the ticket speculated about — it's more likely a **session/auth edge case** that makes the watchlist page silently render as empty when the user is
